text:
Phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high intensity exercise is not instantaneous; the fast phase restores roughly 70–85% within 30–60 seconds, with near-complete resynthesis typically taking about 3–5 minutes and full restoration up to about 5–8 minutes. The team note is incorrect because resynthesis depends on oxidative ATP production and is therefore time-dependent, not a direct chemical reversal completed within seconds.
CONFIDENCE: 85
